Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include only either a purple Digimon card with [Ravemon] in its name or [Bird] or [Avian] in one of its traits or a [Keenan Crier], can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a purple Digimon card with [Ravemon] in its name or [Bird] or [Avian] in one of its traits and 1 [Keenan Crier], can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 purple Digimon card with [Ravemon] in its name or [Bird] or [Avian] in one of its traits and 1 [Keenan Crier] among them to your hand. Place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.
Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
